name: All in One – AI Product Manager for WooCommerce
author: Jcodex

sections.description:
Most WooCommerce stores have products that quietly cost them sales: no meta description, a thin or copied supplier description, no alt text, no FAQ. Most owners never find out which ones.

All in One – AI Product Manager shows you exactly what is wrong, then fixes it inside the WooCommerce product editor.

  1. See it. Every product gets a free Product Health Score out of 100.
  2. Find it. The free Missing Content Scanner checks your whole catalog in one pass.
  3. Fix it. One click generates the missing descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, features, benefits and images.

No API key. No OpenAI account. No setup. Install, open a product, click.

Step 1: Product Health Score (free, unlimited)

Open any product and see a score out of 100, with each item marked done, weak or missing:

  • Content: title, short description, long description length, benefits, FAQ
  • SEO: SEO title, meta description length, focus keyword, keyword usage
  • Images: featured image, alt text, image count
  • Conversion: FAQ, clear benefits, title strength

Click Improve Product with AI and the plugin generates only what is flagged.

Step 2: Missing Content Scanner (free, unlimited)

Running a store with hundreds of products? Stop clicking through them one by one. The scanner reports how many products are:

  • Missing SEO descriptions or meta descriptions
  • Missing images or image alt text
  • Missing FAQs
  • Using very short descriptions
  • Using duplicate or near-duplicate descriptions

Then jump straight to the products that need work.

Step 3: Generate content inside the product editor

The panel sits right in the WooCommerce product editor (Classic and Block Editor). Nothing saves until you click Update or Publish, so you can edit or discard anything.

  • Product descriptions with tone, length and audience controls
  • Short descriptions
  • SEO titles and meta descriptions
  • Tags (one-click apply)
  • Feature and benefit lists
  • Product name improvement ideas
  • AI product images (ecommerce, lifestyle, luxury and minimal styles), saved to your Media Library with automatic alt text

Free regenerate: didn’t like a result? Click Generate again with the same inputs within 15 minutes for a fresh version. It doesn’t use a credit.

Works with your SEO plugin, or without one

  • Writes SEO titles and meta descriptions directly into Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO when one is active.
  • If none is installed, the plugin provides its own built-in SEO title and meta description fields and saves them with the product.

Free vs Pro

Free (forever, resets monthly)

  • Product Health Score: unlimited
  • Missing Content Scanner: unlimited
  • 10 generations per month for each content type: descriptions, short descriptions, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, features, benefits, tags and name ideas
  • Tones: Sales-Focused, SEO Optimized, Luxury, Casual
  • Lengths: Short, Medium, Long
  • Audiences: General, Men, Women, Kids, B2B
  • Free regenerate within 15 minutes

Pro (unlimited, built for catalogs)

Speed and scale

  • Unlimited generation for every content type
  • Bulk generator: descriptions, short descriptions, SEO, tags, features, benefits and FAQ for selected products, categories or your whole catalog
  • One-click Generate All
  • Bulk image generation

Better SEO

  • Focus keyword and long-tail keyword suggestions
  • Product SEO audit with recommendations
  • FAQ generator with schema markup for Google rich results

More product content

  • Attributes generator (auto-creates WooCommerce attributes)
  • Specifications tables
  • Comparison tables
  • Rewrite existing content: improve, humanize, expand, shorten or persuade
  • Import from a product URL (Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy or any supplier) and generate unique content

Images and marketing

  • Lifestyle scenes, product mockups, background removal and upscaling
  • Ad copy (Facebook, Instagram, Google, Pinterest), email copy and video scripts (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts)

Languages and agencies

  • English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic and Urdu; WPML and Polylang compatible
  • CSV import/export
  • Custom prompt templates, plus more writing styles (Professional, Friendly, Technical) and tones (Formal, Persuasive, Premium)

Compare plans and upgrade to Pro (30-day refund guarantee)

Who is it for?

  • Store owners who add products regularly and don’t want to write every listing by hand
  • Dropshippers and importers who need unique content instead of copied supplier text
  • Print-on-demand shops with hundreds of products that each need their own copy
  • Agencies and freelancers managing client stores
  • Anyone who wants better product SEO without hiring a copywriter

Why store owners choose it

  • Diagnose first: it tells you what is missing before it writes anything.
  • No API key: nothing to configure and no separate AI subscription.
  • Native to WooCommerce: fills the real description, short description, tag and featured image fields.
  • Monthly free allowance: not a one-time trial.
  • No frontend code: it doesn’t affect your store’s speed.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JCodex API (https://jcodex.com/wp-json/apg/v1) to process generation requests. Requests are sent only when a logged-in admin or editor clicks Generate inside the product editor.

Data sent: your site’s public URL and the prompt built from your product content.

  • JCodex Terms of Use: https://jcodex.com/terms/
  • JCodex Privacy Policy: https://jcodex.com/privacy/

JCodex may use OpenAI on its backend. Their policies apply to prompt processing:

  • OpenAI Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

No customer personal data is collected or transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for AI Product Manager for WooCommerce, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Open any product (Products > Add New, or edit an existing one).
  4. Find the AI Product Generator panel near the top. It opens with that product’s Health Score.
  5. Click Improve Product with AI, or choose a specific tab such as Description, Image or SEO Title.
  6. Review, edit if needed, then Update or Publish.
  7. To check your whole catalog, open the Missing Content Scanner from the plugin’s main menu.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key, OpenAI account or ChatGPT subscription?

No. The plugin connects to the JCodex API, which handles AI processing for you. Install it and start generating.

Is the free version really free?

Yes. The Health Score and Missing Content Scanner are free and unlimited. Each content type also has its own free allowance of 10 generations per month, refreshed on a rolling 30-day cycle. Anything you’ve already generated stays in place.

What happens when I use up my free generations?

You’ll be offered an upgrade to Pro for unlimited generation. If you don’t upgrade, your allowance refreshes with the next cycle.

Can I regenerate a result without using another credit?

Yes. Click Generate again with the exact same settings within 15 minutes and it counts as a free regenerate. This applies once per generation.

What is the Product Health Score?

A free score out of 100 for each product, covering content, SEO, images and conversion elements. Each item is marked done, weak or missing, and Improve Product with AI generates whatever is flagged.

Can it scan my whole catalog for missing content?

Yes. The Missing Content Scanner is free and unlimited. It reports missing SEO and meta descriptions, images, alt text and FAQs, plus short or duplicate descriptions.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Yes. Generated SEO titles and meta descriptions are written directly into the active SEO plugin’s fields.

What if I don’t use an SEO plugin?

The plugin provides built-in SEO title and meta description fields and saves them with the product when you click Update or Publish.

How do I generate content for many products at once?

Bulk generation is in Pro. Run it on selected products, categories or your entire catalog.

Can I import a product from Amazon or AliExpress and rewrite it?

Yes, in Pro. Import from a product URL and the plugin generates unique, SEO-friendly content, which helps you avoid duplicate-content issues.

Does it support multiple languages?

Pro supports English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic and Urdu, and works with WPML and Polylang.

Does it add image alt text automatically?

Yes. Every generated image gets alt text from the product title (or your image prompt if the product has no title yet).

Where are generated images saved?

In your Media Library, set as the featured image with alt text applied.

Does it work with the Block Editor and Classic Editor?

Yes, both.

Can I edit AI content before publishing?

Yes. Content is placed into the product fields, but nothing is saved until you click Update or Publish.

Will it slow down my store?

No. API calls happen only when you click Generate in the admin product editor. There is no frontend code.

Is it GDPR friendly?

The plugin sends only your site URL and the generation prompt built from your product content. No customer personal data is collected or transmitted. See the JCodex Privacy Policy for details.
sections.changelog:
1.2.6

Implement missing content scanner
add new plugins dashboard

1.2.5

  • New settings page to manage plugin options
  • Security improvements

1.2.4

  • Merged the Missing Content Scanner and the Product Scanner into one All Products Scanner: scans all products in small batches and reports missing or very short titles, descriptions and short descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, images, image ALT text, FAQs, tags, categories, attributes, SKUs and prices, plus duplicate/similar descriptions, with a Health Score and a product list for each issue
  • The All Products Scanner can be filtered by product status, product type and category
  • Added Brand Voice: define your brand name, industry, target customer, personality and writing style, and every AI generation follows it (advanced options are in Pro)
  • Added a Content Language setting (AI Product Manager > Dashboard, with a Change language link inside the product editor panel): leave it on Automatic to follow the WordPress site language or choose any supported language for AI-generated content
  • AI content now follows the WordPress site language: descriptions, short descriptions, features, benefits, tags, SEO titles, meta descriptions, name suggestions and Product Health insights are generated in the language set under Settings > General > Site Language (developers can override it with the jcodex_apgwco_content_language filter)
  • Added a main “AI Product Manager” menu with a Dashboard page and submenus for the All Products Scanner and Brand Voice
  • Added a Settings link on the Plugins page that opens the plugin Dashboard
  • AI Product Image: the description field is now required and the source photo upload is now optional — you can generate an image from a text description alone, or upload a photo for the AI to match
  • Removed the non-functional “Fix with AI” button from the Product Health results
  • Added built-in SEO title and meta description fields for stores that do not have Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO installed.
  • Generated SEO titles and meta descriptions can now be saved with the product through the plugin’s own SEO fields.
  • Updated the SEO workflow so it can use supported SEO plugins when available and the plugin’s built-in fields when they are not.

1.2.3

fix an ux issue with generate buttons

1.2.2

  • Added the Product Health Score — a free, per-product score out of 100 across content, SEO, images, and conversion, with a done/weak/missing checklist
  • Added Improve Product with AI — one-click generation for whatever the Health Score flags
  • Added the Missing Content Scanner — a free, catalog-wide scan for missing descriptions, meta descriptions, images, alt text, and FAQs, plus short or duplicate descriptions
  • Added Fix with AI on the scanner results to jump straight into generation

1.2.1

  • Free generations now refresh every month instead of a one-time lifetime cap
  • Added free regenerate — re-click Generate with the same inputs within 15 minutes at no extra credit cost
  • Generated images now get automatic alt text (from product title or image prompt)
  • SEO titles and meta descriptions now write directly into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO when active
  • Added a usage-cycle note inside the panel so users know when free monthly limits reset

1.2.0

  • Added limited product description, short description, and image generation
  • Added feature list, benefit list, and tag generators
  • Added AI panel inside the WooCommerce product editor, with Classic and Block Editor support
  • Auto-fill for description, short description, and featured image
  • Added basic SEO title and meta description generation
  • Added product name improvement suggestions
  • Free tier: 10 descriptions, 10 short descriptions, 10 images, 10 SEO titles — no API key required

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Product description and image generation inside the WooCommerce product editor
  • Auto-save generated images to the Media Library
  • Auto-fill description and short description fields, auto-set featured image
  • Basic SEO title and meta description generation

  • Freemium usage limits for free-tier users
  • Classic Editor and Block Editor support
